title: Beckwith's neutrino light detector seized by the NRO
summary: Steven Greer tells of Beckwith's neutrino light detector seized by the NRO, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: invented was a detector that would pick up nutrino light, a burst of nutrino. He got a national security order from the NRO, National Reconnaissance Office,

plain: A UFO activist, Steven Greer, tells podcast host Jesse Michels what an inventor named Bob Beckwith told him. According to Greer, Beckwith invented a detector that could pick up bursts of light from neutrinos, tiny particles that pass through almost everything, and was then hit with a national security order from the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites. If true, it would mean the government is locking away inventions that touch on these secrets.
